title: Lipschitz push-forward operator: conjuncts (1)–(6) and the smooth-approximation property (PA)
statement: Assume (VO), the vanishing-off-support antecedent: for all P, n, U, S ∈ 𝒟_n(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U n) and ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) with tsupport ω disjoint from spt S, S(ω) = 0; (REP), the mass-representation antecedent: for U open and T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) with M_W(T) < ∞ for every open W ⊂⊂ U there are a measure μ (μ(Uᶜ) = 0, finite on compact subsets of U) and ξ : ℝ^P → MultiVector P n (μ-a.e. strongly measurable, |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for all x, α) with M_W(T) = μ(W) for every open W, T(ω) = ∫ ξ(x)(ω(x)) dμ for all ω, and, if also M_W(∂T) < ∞ for open W ⊂⊂ U, μ(E) = 0 whenever Hⁿ(E) = 0; and (LB), the covector-bounds antecedent (exactly the frozen type of the parent's covector-bounds dependency): (L1) |β.compContinuousLinearMap A| ≤ ‖A‖^k·|β| for every continuous linear A : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'} and k-covector β on ℝ^{N'}; (L2) |β.curryLeft v| ≤ ‖v‖·|β| for v ∈ ℝ^N and every (k+1)-covector β on ℝ^N; (L3) |α(τ)| ≤ |α| for orthonormal τ (exact frozen Lean types, written as antecedents). Then there are maps lpush_{N,N',k} : (ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'}) → 𝒟_k(ℝ^N) → 𝒟_k(ℝ^{N'}) (all N, N', k; currents on univ) such that, for all Λ ∈ ℝ≥0, (1) lpush(id, X) = X for NC X (spt X compact, M(X) < ∞, boundaryMassOn X univ < ∞); (2) lpush(F, X − Y) = lpush(F, X) − lpush(F, Y) for Λ-Lipschitz F and NC X, Y; (3) lpush(F, X) = lpush(G, X) for Λ-Lipschitz F, G, NC X and F = G on spt X; (4) M(lpush(F, X)) ≤ Λ^k·M(X) and spt lpush(F, X) ⊆ F(spt X) for Λ-Lipschitz F and NC X; (5) ∂ lpush(F, X) = lpush(F, ∂X) for Λ-Lipschitz F and X ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^N) with compact support, M(X) < ∞ and M(∂X) < ∞; (6) for Λ-Lipschitz F and NC X there are C^∞ (ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞)) Λ-Lipschitz maps F_j converging to F uniformly on ℝ^N such that for every ω ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^{N'}) there are η_j ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^N), each equal to F_j^#ω on some open set containing spt X, with X(η_j) → lpush(F, X)(ω); and (PA) for all N, N', k ∈ ℕ, Λ ∈ ℝ≥0, Λ' ∈ ℝ, every Λ-Lipschitz F : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'}, every X ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^N) with compact support, M(X) < ∞ and boundaryMassOn X univ < ∞, every sequence of C^∞ maps F_j : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'} with ‖DF_j(x)‖ ≤ Λ' for all j and x ∈ spt X and F_j → F uniformly on spt X (TendstoUniformlyOn), every ω ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^{N'}) and every sequence η_j ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^N) such that each η_j equals F_j^#ω on some open set containing spt X: X(η_j) → lpush(F, X)(ω). Conjuncts (1)–(6) are verbatim the corresponding conjuncts of the parent statement; F^#ω(x) := (ω(F x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ F x).
